title: Paper Laboratory Terminal
summary: A warm light terminal palette with ink-like text, sage prompts, and restrained research-state colors.
details: Paper Laboratory Terminal is intended for bright rooms and light TheoX workbenches. It keeps command output readable on a warm surface while preserving clear distinctions among paths, warnings, failures, and successful verification.
features: Warm light background for bright-room terminal work
Ink-like foreground with sage prompt and cursor colors
Accessible ANSI colors tuned for a light surface
Inert fixed colors with no scripts, fonts, or remote assets
